name: nt2_prod_divisors_sq
statement: (n : ℕ) : (∏ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d) ^ 2 = n ^ (Nat.divisors n).card
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), (∏ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d) ^ 2 = n ^ (Nat.divisors n).card
informal: The square of the product of the divisors of n equals n^{d(n)}.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), (∏ d ∈ n.divisors, d) ^ 2 = n ^ n.divisors.card
